about.title: About Me
about.quote: Good design starts with an understanding of psychology and technology.
about.description: My approach to UI/UX design is rooted in my IT foundation. I'm passionate about perfecting the user experience. With a background in software engineering, I combine technical expertise with creative vision to build products that are both beautiful and functional.

process.title: Discovery & Strategy
process.description: Understanding project goals, user needs, and technical requirements to create a solid foundation.

process.title: Design & Prototyping
process.description: Creating pixel-perfect designs in Figma with accessibility and responsiveness in mind.

process.title: Development & Implementation
process.description: Converting designs to production-ready code using React, Next.js and modern web standards.

process.title: Testing & Optimization
process.description: Ensuring WCAG 2.2 AA compliance, performance optimization, and cross-browser compatibility.

findbeauty.title: FindBeauty
findbeauty.introduction: Users frequently experience 'choice overload' when navigating thousands of cosmetic options. My objective was finding the right product in the shortest time possible.

roles.title: Segmented User Flows
roles.description: Designed two distinct pathways: 'Experienced' (filters and comparisons) and 'Novice' (AI-driven skin analysis quiz).

roles.title: Comparison System
roles.description: Developed an intuitive, side-by-side comparison interface to reduce cognitive load by eliminating the need for tab-switching.

roles.title: Advanced Filtering
roles.description: Engineered a multi-criteria filtering system with rigorous logic to ensure the highest result accuracy.

findbeauty.outcome: Achieved >85% positive feedback from teacher and students in usability testing due to the refined, personalized interface.

techdies.title: Techdies
techdies.introduction: My objective was to transform English learning from a repetitive task into an immersive "Space Exploration" adventure in order to maintain a child's focus during language acquisition

roles.title: Gamified UX Architecture
roles.description: Integrated diverse game mechanics, including Leaderboards, Flashcards, and interactive 'Missions' to sustain long-term motivation.

roles.title: Mascot & Branding
roles.description: Utilized Adobe Illustrator and Figma to build 'Techdies' mascot and background elements which are suitable for the brand's playful and educational identity.

techdies.outcome: Sustained high user retention with >70% positive rating from teachers and parents. Successfully authored the GELW_SRS document, ensuring total alignment between business analysis and technical implementation.

serinity_hotel.title: SERINITY HOTEL
serinity_hotel.introduction: Complex booking processes are often the primary driver of user drop-offs. My objective was to design a platform that embodies 'Serenity' by enabling users to search, compare, and book in just a few minimalist steps

roles.title: Hero-Centric Booking Engine
roles.description: Placed core booking tools at the heart of the Home page to drive immediate user action.

roles.title: Comprehensive User Dashboard
roles.description: Developed 'My Booking' pages for seamless stay management, enhancing personalization and long-term user retention.

serinity_hotel.outcome: Built a comprehensive UI Kit for the hotel web platform, ensuring high scalability for future features.

techmind.title: TechMind
techmind.description: Comprehensive Admin Suite for EdTech Monitoring & Content Control
techmind.introduction: The goal was to design a dashboard that empowers administrators to oversee user activity, manage content, and ensure a safe learning environment with ease and efficiency.

roles.title: Data-Driven Dashboard
roles.description: Utilized line and doughnut charts to visualize user growth and subscription rates. The design prioritizes Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in high-visibility zones.

roles.title: Resource & Content Management
roles.description: Optimized the workflow for uploading lessons and managing vocabulary/multimedia resources through a form interface, significantly reducing data entry errors.

techmind.outcome: The project resulted in a highly engaging and user-friendly platform that significantly improved user satisfaction and conversion rates.
